text:
support: Customer reported sudden 5xx spike and timeouts on hosted inference across multiple endpoints. They also see intermittent auth errors (403) and billing-check failures in the same window. Customer ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/ticket/RC-4921 :sos:

sara: Thanks — putting this into an incident channel. Mike, can you take on-call until we have initial triage?

mike: I’m on it. Looking at gateway metrics now — p50 latency ok but p95/p99 shot up around 09:12 UTC. 5xx rate ~3.8% for the customer’s routes.

ashok: Pasted a snippet from the logs:
```
2026-03-16T09:12:37Z gateway: route=/v1/generate status=502 backend=hosted-inference-1 err="upstream reset" customer_id=acct_42
2026-03-16T09:12:38Z auth: token_verify failed status=403 reason="billing_check_failed" cust=acct_42
```

ashok: Looks like a cascade: some backends reset, auth layer returns billing_check_failed for the same token (race with billing service).

support: Customer says they started seeing errors when retrying bulk requests with larger batches. They’ve throttled down but still intermittently hit timeouts.

tess: I’m toggling fallback routing to route requests for acct_42 to the lower-cost model variant (cpu-friendly) until we stabilize. Applying policy now.

oncall-bot: Pager acknowledged by mike. Incident ID: INC-2026-0428-1.

mike: Confirmed fallback applied. Observed immediate drop in 5xx for routed requests, overall error rate still elevated due to auth/billing failures.

jordan: Billing team flagged a short outage in the billing aggregate that caused token checks to intermittently fail for some customers at ~09:10-09:20 UTC. That aligns with the auth errors. They’re rolling a hotfix.

ashok: Actionable repro: curl against gateway with bulk payload (10K tokens) -> observe 504 timeout after 30s. Small single request passes. Repro command: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @bulk.json --max-time 35`

sara: Notes for customer comms: explain cascading failure (billing check flapped -> auth returned 403 -> gateway retried -> backend queue grew -> timeouts/5xx). We mitigated with fallback routing and billing hotfix.

support-bot: Customer ticket RC-4921 updated: mitigation steps applied, asked customer to monitor and provide any failing request IDs.

mike: Immediate mitigation summary: 1) fallback routing for acct_42; 2) increased gateway connection pool to hosted-inference backends; 3) temporary relax of retry policy at gateway (no aggressive retry on 5xx from auth). These reduced visible 5xx.

sara: Postmortem follow-up items (assignments inline):
- ACTION: add per-token billing check tracing to correlate token failures with billing service (owner: jordan)
- ACTION: update runbook to include immediate fallback mapping when auth upstream failures detected (owner: tess)
- ACTION: add short-circuit for billing_check_failed so gateway returns explicit 402/403 without retrying (owner: mike)
- ACTION: tune batch-size advisory in SDK docs and add server-side safeguards against oversized bulk requests (owner: product)
- ACTION: add alert that joins gateway 5xx + auth 4xx spikes within 2m window (owner: eng-infra)
